category: Configure Compilation, Interpreter, and Build Processes to Improve Executable Security (PW)
subcategory_text: Configure the build to enable compiler and interpreter security features (e.g., ASLR, stack canaries, control-flow integrity, RELRO) appropriate to the platform.
implementation_examples: Enable DEP/NX, ASLR, and CET where supported
Use safe interpreters with sandbox options enabled by default
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the build enables platform hardening features.
Determine whether hardening settings are tracked and verified.
